parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the main switch plate of a wall switch, made of durable polycarbonate plastic. It is the part that users press to toggle the electrical circuit.
parts.Functional_description: It functions as the actuator that opens or closes the electrical circuit when pressed, controlling the flow of electricity to a connected device or light.
parts.Movement_description: It moves slightly inward and outward when pressed, pivoting or depressing to make or break the electrical contact.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or mounting frame of the wall switch, typically made of ABS plastic. It provides structural support and houses the internal electrical components.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the switch mechanism securely in place and attaches to the wall or electrical box, ensuring stability and insulation.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during normal operation.
